title: dynamic-tenant-audit-routing-and-s3-lifecycle-policies
author: Saira Kapoor
description: Motivation: Private deployments need finer-grained retention and export controls for tenant audit streams so compliance teams can place tenant data into different archival tiers and lifecycle policies. This PR implements dynamic tenant-level routing for the audit-log-exporter, adds Terraform modules to provision S3 lifecycle policies and cross-account roles, and updates the Helm chart to include pre-upgrade snapshot hooks and a conservative rollback path. Summary of changes: 1) Runtime: introduce a pluggable routing layer that inspects tenant metadata and routes audit events to either existing sinks or to per-tenant S3 buckets; supports regex-based tenant selectors and a default fallback sink. 2) Terraform: new module redwood_audit_bucket with lifecycle_rule and policy templates for infrequent access transition and 365/90/30-day retention presets; creates an IAM role with assume-role trust for the exporter service. 3) Helm: values schema extended with tenantRouting and lifecyclePolicy sections; a pre-upgrade Job is added to snapshot in-flight offsets to a PVC and an annotation that enables rolling back to the previous chart with minimal data loss. 4) Private installer: installer manifest generator gains a new auditBuckets mapping and KMSKeyRef wiring; on-prem package supports filesystem archival sink alongside S3. 5) Migration scripts: provided scripts/terraform-to-helm-migration.sh that converts existing terraform bucket configs into Helm values for clusters that are migrated from Dedicated/Terraform-managed infra to a Helm-managed Private install. 6) Tests & CI: added integration tests that spin up a minio instance and exercise routing, lifecycle transitions, and restore from snapshots. Rollout plan and safety: feature guarded behind a feature flag (AUDIT_ROUTER_V2) and defaulted off for existing private installs. The PR includes a straightforward rollback plan (disable flag, redeploy previous chart, run restore job that replays buffered events from PVC or S3). Also documents KMS key rotation considerations and an automated secrets sync hook for cross-account role credentials. Backwards compatibility: default behavior remains unchanged when tenantRouting is unset. Compliance notes: per-tenant retention is auditable via emitted metrics and structured events; Terraform module emits audit trail tags. See linked Linear tasks for scope and migration coordination.
